# S3's reference solution (task-036)

What the fake agent writes in each step of S3@1.0, so that a run's snapshots hold code S3's hidden tests
can pass: `01/` to `05/` are laid over the workspace in turn (`test/support/reference.ts`). Step 1 records
the school's rules in `DECISIONS.md`; step 4 records D3's revision there, which D3's content check reads
(REQ-SCO-06). It is public, as S3's oracle is. It is not the benchmark's code, and it is never shown to
an agent.
